title: tool_parsecfg: accept indented options and CRLF line endings again
body:
Since curl 8.13.0, config files with indented option lines or with CRLF line endings fail to parse:

- a7fda9a8f moved comment handling into my_get_line() and with it the skipping of leading whitespace, so an indented option line is now parsed as an empty option name.

- 1503555836 made the option name end at ISBLANK() instead of ISSPACE(), so for an option without argument on a CRLF line the CR becomes part of the name, e.g. "head\r" is reported as unknown. A line with only a CR is also taken as an option name.

Skip leading whitespace and ignore whitespace-only lines in parseconfig(), and end the option name at any whitespace again.

Tests 3040 and 3041 verify.

files.patch:
@@ -43,14 +43,15 @@ header = "a: a"
 data = "a"
 </file1>
 <file2 name="%LOGDIR/config%TESTNUMBER-b">
---next
-url = %HOSTIP:%HTTPPORT/%TESTNUMBER0002
-header = "b: b"
-data = "b"
+  --next
+	url = %HOSTIP:%HTTPPORT/%TESTNUMBER0002
+    header = "b: b"
+ 	data = "b"
 </file2>
-<file3 name="%LOGDIR/config%TESTNUMBER-c">
+<file3 name="%LOGDIR/config%TESTNUMBER-c" crlf="yes">
 --next
 url = %HOSTIP:%HTTPPORT/%TESTNUMBER0003
+
 header = "c: c"
 data = "c"
 </file3>
@@ -59,7 +60,7 @@ data = "c"
 http
 </server>
 <name>
-Three -K uses with --next and --data in each
+Three -K uses with --next and --data in each, indented and CRLF lines
 </name>
 <command>
 -K %LOGDIR/config%TESTNUMBER-a -K %LOGDIR/config%TESTNUMBER-b -K %LOGDIR/config%TESTNUMBER-c
